question: Show the unique activity titles, locations, term start date, and supervisor name for all independent activities, sorted by the ascending order of start date.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE independent_activities AS
WITH detail AS (
  SELECT 
    d.activity_title,
    d.term_code,
    d.iap_subject_session_key,
    d.iap_subject_person_key,
    d.enrollment_type
  FROM beaver."IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL" d
),
leader AS (
  SELECT 
    p.iap_subject_person_key,
    p.person_name AS supervisor_name
  FROM beaver."IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON" p
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(p.person_role, '')) IN (
    'activity leader','leader','supervisor','instructor','organizer','coordinator'
  )
),
sess AS (
  SELECT s.iap_subject_session_key, s.session_location
  FROM beaver."IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION" s
),
terms AS (
  SELECT t.term_code, t.term_start_date
  FROM beaver."ACADEMIC_TERMS" t
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
  d.activity_title,
  s.session_location,
  d.term_code,
  t.term_start_date,
  p.supervisor_name
FROM detail d
LEFT JOIN sess s ON s.iap_subject_session_key = d.iap_subject_session_key
LEFT JOIN terms t ON t.term_code = d.term_code
LEFT JOIN leader p ON p.iap_subject_person_key = d.iap_subject_person_key
WHERE (
  d.enrollment_type IS NULL 
  OR LOWER(d.enrollment_type) LIKE '%independent%'
) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.activity_title), ''), '') <> ''

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "independent_activities" AS SELECT 
  ACTIVITY_TITLE AS activity_title,
  SESSION_LOCATION AS session_location,
  TERM_CODE AS term_code,

  supervisor_name
FROM independent_activities

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    d.activity_title,
    s.session_location,
    d.term_code,
    at.term_start_date,
    p.person_name AS supervisor_name
  FROM beaver.iap_subject_detail d
  LEFT JOIN beaver.iap_subject_session s
    ON d.iap_subject_session_key = s.iap_subject_session_key
  LEFT JOIN beaver.academic_terms at
    ON at.term_code = d.term_code
  LEFT JOIN beaver.iap_subject_person p
    ON d.iap_subject_person_key = p.iap_subject_person_key
  WHERE (
    COALESCE(UPPER(d.enrollment_type),'') LIKE '%INDEPENDENT%'
    OR COALESCE(UPPER(d.activity_title),'') LIKE '%INDEPENDENT%'
    OR COALESCE(UPPER(d.activity_description),'') LIKE '%INDEPENDENT%'
  )
  AND (p.person_role ILIKE '%leader%' OR p.person_role ILIKE '%supervisor%' OR p.person_role ILIKE '%instructor%')
)
SELECT activity_title, session_location AS location, term_start_date, supervisor_name
FROM base
ORDER BY try_strptime(term_start_date, '%d-%b-%y') ASC NULLS LAST, activity_title
LIMIT 200;

WITH prep AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    activity_title,

    supervisor_name,
    -- Try multiple common date formats; fall back to NULL if none match
    COALESCE(
      try_strptime(term_start_date, '%d-%b-%y'),
      try_strptime(term_start_date, '%d-%b-%Y'),
      try_strptime(term_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d'),
      try_strptime(term_start_date, '%d-%m-%Y'),
      try_strptime(term_start_date, '%m/%d/%Y')
    ) AS start_dt
  FROM independent_activities
)
SELECT activity_title, location, term_start_date, supervisor_name
FROM prep
ORDER BY start_dt ASC NULLS LAST, activity_title
LIMIT 200;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "independent_activities" AS WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    d.activity_title,
    COALESCE(s.session_location, sch.meet_place) AS session_location,
    d.term_code,
    at.term_start_date,
    COALESCE(p.person_name, '') AS supervisor_name
  FROM beaver."IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL" d
  LEFT JOIN beaver."IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON" p
    ON d.iap_subject_person_key = p.iap_subject_person_key
  LEFT JOIN beaver."IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION" s
    ON d.iap_subject_session_key = s.iap_subject_session_key
  LEFT JOIN beaver."SUBJECT_IAP_SCHEDULE" sch
    ON d.term_code = sch.term_code
  LEFT JOIN beaver."ACADEMIC_TERMS" at
    ON at.term_code = d.term_code
  WHERE (d.is_cancelled IS NULL OR d.is_cancelled <> 'Y')
    AND d.term_code LIKE '%JA'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  activity_title,
  session_location,
  term_code,
  term_start_date,
  supervisor_name
FROM base

WITH prep AS (

)
